description: This Java class, InstallApk, demonstrates how to programmatically install and uninstall APK files on Android devices using intents such as ACTION_INSTALL_PACKAGE and ACTION_UNINSTALL_PACKAGE. It includes methods for handling button clicks, copying APK files from assets to internal storage, and managing installation results.

classes.name: InstallApk
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating APK install/uninstall through intents, handling user interaction, and managing APK file preparation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and binds button click listeners.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result from install/uninstall activities, displaying appropriate user messages.

methods.name: getApkUri
methods.description: Prepares the APK file from assets and returns a content URI (FileProvider) or file URI for installation.
